classification: Observable finite acceptance floor routing, not exhaustive correctness proof

floors.requirement: Accept at least one complete legitimate native/task case as no observed task breach with verified useful completion, with specific exact amounts and receipt references.
Detect the actual useful-completion plus narrower task-excess episode from bound distinct native attempts, without blaming a guard for an unrequested invoice feature.
Accept legitimate separate intentB with equal amount/recipient, and deduplicate repeated observation of one signed attempt. Counts must name their unit.
Differentiate native committed credit from rootPaid/counter claim, containing-batch rollback and later callback failure. PreserveSuccessReceiptId committed semantics.
Treat positiveFunctionCall deposit and controlled routed funding according to explicit native/economic roles; do not silently implementTransfer-only completeness.
Handle raw current same-account initial omission with derived provenance or explicitly scoped unsupported output; do not claim support for third guard if all its cases are unsupported.
Keep actual allowed free utility and invalid paid-content controls distinct, enforcing declared source/content obligations rather than completed boolean or HTTP200.
Do not attribute unrelated same-amount credit to failed owner intent inC32. Account balance is corroboration under assumptions, not the causal identity key.
Deliberately incomplete, contradictory and unsupported financial evidence must not return complete-clean. Independently positive facts and scoped breach remain visible when other axes lack evidence.
Missing input, invalid representation, resource limit, unsupported profile and ordinary paid/refunded zero outcomes are distinct diagnostics; exact zero cannot become an absent default.
Preserve actual pending-to-final progression without duplicate effects/false immutable conflicts; never use scalar>= for the two incomparable status branches.

Run actual final code from documented commands on the intended Windows environment and at least one clean isolated reproduction path when feasible; measure source/runtime/evidence footprint separately and report tested limits.

Retain legitimate authorized multi-action and instalment controls: explicitly amount-compliant settlement cannot be called duplicate solely because it has two action indices or signed hashes; counts must use the declared unit.

Distinguish permitted intermediate delivery failure from designated terminal task utility. SS02 intermediate402 followed by valid terminal response/observed answer can complete its predeclared eventual task; wrong required final answer cannot be replaced by a favorable earlier or recomputed answer.

scopeLimitations: See THREAT_MODEL.fa.txt and FIRST_FAILURES.json; clean reproduction result is a separate actual execution report.
